task: Generate one photorealistic reference photo of a single product, front view, to be used as the exact visual reference of this product in every later image. The product must match "product" exactly; the label must be perfectly legible and correctly spelled.

output.look: clean, realistic product reference photo taken with a phone, true-to-life colors

product.name: CUMBRE specialty ground coffee, 340 g bag (a fictional brand)
product.bag: a stand-up coffee pouch (doypack) with a flat bottom gusset, about 22 cm tall and 13 cm wide (roughly the length of an adult open hand), made of matte coffee-black paper (#16110D) with a smooth, non-glossy finish, no window, standing upright, filled and naturally creased
product.top: the top edge is heat-sealed straight across, with a thin solid copper (#C8833A) strip along the seal
product.label: printed directly on the front of the bag, centered in its upper-middle part, flat matte print, no paper sticker
product.artwork: above the text, a minimalist mountain drawn with only a few thin copper (#C8833A) lines: one continuous outline of two overlapping peaks, the taller one in the center, no fill, no shading, no sun, no other shapes
product.label_text: exactly two centered lines of text and nothing else: 'CUMBRE' in large, tall, condensed cream (#F3EBDD) sans-serif capital letters (Oswald style), and below it 'CAFÉ DE ALTURA' in small copper (#C8833A) sans-serif capital letters with wide letter spacing; no other words or numbers, and no graphics besides the thin-line mountain
product.rule: the product must look exactly like this in every image: same shape, proportions, colors, materials, mountain drawing, label design and label text

composition.view: straight front view at the product's mid-height, the label facing the camera and centered
composition.framing: the whole product in frame, centered, filling about 60% of the image height, with even space around it
composition.surface: standing upright on a plain light warm-gray matte surface, a soft natural contact shadow under it
composition.background: plain light warm-gray seamless background, nothing else in the image

lighting.key: soft, even, diffused daylight from the front, like a window behind the camera
lighting.mood: neutral and accurate colors, low contrast, soft natural highlights, no harsh reflections over the label

realism_rules: true-to-life materials with their real texture, transparency and reflections
real printed label, flat print, crisp letters
correct proportions, perfectly upright, no distortion
negative: any text other than the label (CUMBRE / CAFÉ DE ALTURA), misspelled letters, extra lines of small text, numbers, icons, barcodes
a second product, props, hands, people, flowers, splashes, decorations
a different shape, color, cap or label than described in "product"
3D render, CGI, illustration, heavy studio advertising look, dramatic lighting, reflections covering the label
